documents.title: Vector DaVinci Configurator Classic: Why Your Project Opens Read-Only

chunks.content: Official-source summary: a DaVinci Project records the identity and delivery version of its BSW Package. DaVinci Configurator Classic 6 stops and opens the project read-only when the installed package identity differs, because package module definitions determine available parameters, permitted values, and generator output. The mismatch dialog exposes both identities and the installed package path. Source: https://help.vector.com/davinci-configurator-classic/en/latest/user-manual/bsw-update/update-bsw-package-behind-the-scenes.html

documents.title: Vector DaVinci Configurator Classic CLI: dvcfg-b project validate

chunks.content: Official-source summary: dvcfg-b project validate checks an ECU configuration for consistency, completeness, and MICROSAR rule compliance. The command requires an explicit DaVinci project and BSW package; module and external-step scope can be selected, and --fail-on controls the severity threshold for a non-zero exit. This scope does not by itself prove that an unrelated Workbench report came from a real DaVinci validation run. Source: https://help.vector.com/davinci-configurator-classic/en/latest/user-manual/references/cli/dvcfg-b/project-validate.html
